statement: For beta > 0 and stored distributions X_1,...,X_N in P_2(R^d), the proposed energy is E(xi)=-(1/beta) log sum_i exp(-beta W_2^2(X_i,xi)); its Wasserstein gradient induces Gibbs-weighted transport toward the stored distributions.
domain: Finite collections of non-degenerate Gaussian distributions with beta > 0.
checks: The implementation equals a direct stable evaluation of the stated formula.
The analytic mean component of the gradient agrees with central finite differences.
For a separated deterministic Gaussian fixture, each stored pattern has lower energy than the fixture centroid.
A sign-reversed gradient negative control is rejected by the independent checker.
